title: RSNA Knee hybrid report labels
subtitle: v4_blend labels with v2 Fracture column; gold macro 0.899
description:
Hybrid weak-label key for RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection, built entirely from two already-public label sets:

- Eleven findings: stevenleehans' llm_labels_v4_blend (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/stevenleehans/rsna-knee-llm-report-labels), macro 0.8927 vs the 58 gold studies.
- Fracture: Pilkwang Kim's report_labels_v2 (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/pilkwang/rsna-knee-llm-labels), which outscores v4 on Fracture 0.8713 vs 0.7931 against gold, on a disagreement surface of only 17 studies. The one study v2 lacks keeps v4's value.

Measured against the 58 gold studies: macro AUC 0.8991.

The substitution was pre-registered on the gold-AUC gap and the tiny substitution surface BEFORE any training run. A greedy per-column best-of-both across all twelve findings would be selection on a 58-study ruler and was deliberately not done.

Schema: StudyInstanceUID, the twelve label columns as soft probabilities, and <finding>__conf weight channels. Conf for the eleven v4 columns is abs(p-0.5)*2, so cells at exactly 0.5 (the labeller's explicit 'report does not address this') get conf 0. Fracture keeps v2's own conf. The filename report_labels_v4hybrid.csv follows the discovery convention used by public baseline notebooks.

All credit for the underlying labelling to the two authors above. This file only composes their work.
